title: Migrate test plugin to contract v2
goal: Migrate plugins/tool/test to the v2 result contract: result_contract:2, mandatory disposition+reason fields on every exit path, interrupted disposition for signal-killed runs (#1747), setsid process-group isolation for release hook (#1748), no artifact path construction in code, valid_verdicts enforced, and all acceptance criteria covered by tests written first.

steps.description: Write failing tests first (red step). Add SPEC-1..10 assertions to test-test.sh covering: (SPEC-1) result_contract=2 at top level; (SPEC-2/3) disposition field present and =complete on pass path; (SPEC-4) disposition=complete on fail path; (SPEC-5) disposition=broken on missing-diff error path; (SPEC-6) reason=missing_diff_patch on that path; (SPEC-7) plugin-specific scalars live under data block, not at top level; (SPEC-8) _test_disposition_from_rc maps rc=143/137/130 to interrupted, rc=1 to broken; (SPEC-9) _test_write_result body contains no reference to artifact_dir (grep guard); (SPEC-10) manifest valid_verdicts covers pass, fail, error. Tag SPEC-1..8 as CHANGE assertions (must fail at baseline schema_version:1 output) and SPEC-9..10 as GUARD assertions. Confirm each CHANGE assertion fails before any implementation change.

Update _test_write_result in plugin.sh to emit the v2 result shape: replace schema_version:1 with result_contract:2 at the top level; add mandatory disposition (passed as argument) and reason fields alongside verdict; move all plugin-specific scalars (exit_code, passed, failed, test_output, diff_applied, test_cmd, run_mode) and optional blocks (timing, tree_sha, lint, coverage, mutation) under a data: sub-object. The degenerate fallback JSON (PIPESTATUS[0]!=0 guard) also gets result_contract:2, disposition=broken, reason=result_write_failed. Signature changes: add disposition as the third positional argument after path and verdict.

Add _test_disposition_from_rc helper and wire disposition on every non-success exit path. _test_disposition_from_rc: rc >= 128 and signal in {SIGTERM=15, SIGKILL=9, SIGINT=2} (i.e. rc in {143,137,130}) → interrupted; all other non-zero rcs → broken. Wire the helper at the main result-emit call site. Remaining structural error paths (missing-diff-patch guard, silent-failure guard, summary_unavailable guard) each explicitly pass disposition=broken and their own reason string. The nuance from #1747 is preserved: rc=0 with unrecognised output is verdict=error disposition=broken (config bug); only a signalled death becomes disposition=interrupted.

Implement setsid-wrapped subprocess spawn and TERM trap for #1748 (#1829 release hook). Wrap the test runner invocation in setsid (or equivalent process-group leader call) so the subprocess tree belongs to a controllable process group. Add a TERM trap that sends SIGTERM to the process group and writes disposition=interrupted to the result file before exiting. The release hook (test_cleanup release branch) sends SIGTERM to the process group and exits — it must not delete the staging directory. Add a test assertion: kill the running plugin mid-test, assert the process group has no surviving members and the staging directory is still present on disk.

Update manifest.yaml: add result_contract: 2 under the provides: section. primary: true output, valid_verdicts, provides.role, provides.events, and inputs: [] are already correctly declared and require no change. The test plugin is T0 (no LLM calls), so no router: budget block is required — omitting it is correct and must be noted, not implied.

Run npm test and verify: (a) all SPEC-1..10 assertions pass in the committed tree; (b) a before/after golden diff of the stage output shows only the schema_version→result_contract rename, the new disposition/reason fields, and data-block restructuring — no behavioural regression on a passing run; (c) the PR body records the SPEC-1..8 red step — the assertion text and exact failure message at the merge-base commit.

notes: The test plugin is T0 (no LLM), so no router budget block is needed in the manifest; the acceptance criterion is satisfied by its absence being intentional. primary:true output is already declared. valid_verdicts, provides.role, and provides.events are already declared — no change needed. The test stage is already wired into deployed.yaml flow under build_test_cycle — no template change required. Coordination with #1772 (zero discovered test files → exit 0) and #1784 (tree_sha) is handled by carrying those fields in the data block of the v2 result with no separate code path. The _ROUTE_PG_PREFIX constant from core/router/route.sh:245 should be reused rather than reinvented when wiring the process-group prefix for setsid in step-4. The RETURN trap must not call rm -rf on the staging directory — only _test_kill_staging_pg; the staging-dir deletion belongs exclusively to test_cleanup purge branch.
